title: [Core] Simplify method bindings

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

The current method bindings (i.e., `binder_common.h`, `method_bind_common.h`, `variant_call.cpp`) are extremely complex & contain a lot of duplicated code for seemingly no reason.
This makes it a lot harder to add new binding types (for example, a `Variant` vararg method with 2 set arguments) and/or unify the Variant method bindings (see #124363, this PR's follow-up). 

This PR greatly simplifies the bindings in 3 commits:
1. Simplifies `binder_common.h`. This has a few side effects; all changes within the commit are strictly necessary for compilation.
This is achieved by adding templated structs that handle method signature extraction, and using those resulting signatures to collapse the number of invocation methods down to the bare minimum: a central invoker, 1 for each of variant/validated/ptr calls, 1 each for API exposure for variant/variant with defauls/validated/ptr calls. 
2. Simplifies `variant_call.cpp`. Now that the binder has been simplified, we can remove a lot of duplicate handling in `variant_call.cpp` by using the binder's signature extraction templates.
3. Simplifies `method_bind_common.h`. Once again, we had a ton of duplicated templates for returns/const/etc... These are all collapsed into three: one for common code, one for instances, and one for static methods. This is achieved by employing automatic signature extraction as well.

The 3 commits would be squashed before merge, as they don't make sense separately, although commit 1 can compile standalone, and commits 2 and 3 only need commit 1 to compile. 

With these, we get a reduction of:
* 323 LOC in `method_bind_common.h`
  * A 70% reduction. This file is reported as having a 35s impact on fresh compilation times, per godotengine/godot/issues/111218, this reduction would theoretically bring it down to ~10s.
* 463 LOC in `binder_common.h`
  * A 70% reduction. This file is reported as having a 30s impact on fresh compilation times, per godotengine/godot/issues/111218, this reduction would theoretically bring it down to ~10s.
* 215 LOC in `variant_call.cpp`
  * A 7.6% reduction. Pretty much useless since it's a `cpp` file.

## Additional information

> AI disclosure: A vast majority (95%+) of the code was written by me. AI use was limited to bug fixing at the intersection of templates+macros, things like a missing `&` or `*`.
